assumptions: The agent's tools target the execute-api endpoint rather than CloudFront, because pointing them at the Distribution would create a CloudFormation dependency cycle.
limitations: The execute-api endpoint is publicly reachable and bypasses WAF; the support agent's tool calls also bypass WAF this way. Routes outside the public list still require a Cognito token.
The us. inference profile can route Claude Haiku 4.5 inference to us-east-2 or us-west-2, although every deployed resource stays in us-east-1.
Aurora auto-pauses at 0 ACU; the first request after a pause waits for resume (Data API retries up to 25 s).
Single Aurora writer, no reader (not shown in connectivity preset).
The AgentCore Runtime path is verified by synth and a local mock only; it has not been deployed.
